$comment: Declarative record of every approved content release promoted into the publication directory, per project-workflow.md v1.1 steps 3 and 4. scripts/import-content.mjs runs the encoding and Markdown integrity checks in src/lib/content/integrity.ts BEFORE any transformation. Any integrity failure aborts the import; the defect returns to ChatGPT for a corrected release artifact and is never repaired here. Only after integrity passes does the script apply the transformations permitted by workflow section 8. Release-record checksums were removed on August 22, 2026 by user decision — validation rests on inspecting the received bytes, which caught every defect that has actually arrived.
